theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hf : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have hs : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      simp only [f, Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def]
      exact ⟨⟨(hB n).1, (hB (n+1)).1, (hB (n+2)).1, (hB (n+3)).1⟩,
        ⟨(hB n).2, (hB (n+1)).2, (hB (n+2)).2, (hB (n+3)).2⟩⟩
    exact (Set.finite_Icc _ _).subset hs
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,hij'⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j :=
    Set.Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := f) (t := Set.range f)
      (fun n => ⟨n, rfl⟩) hf
  have heq := hij'
  have hstep : ∀ k l : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → 4 ≤ l →
      u (k-1) = u (l-1) → u (k-2) = u (l-2) → u (k-3) = u (l-3) → u (k-4) = u (l-4) → u k = u l := by
    intro k l hk hl h1 h2 h3 h4
    have hreal : (u k : ℝ) = (u l : ℝ) :=
      (hu k hk).1.trans (by rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]; exact (hu l hl).1.symm)
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hshift : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.1) heq
      | 1 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.2.1) heq
      | 2 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.2.2.1) heq
      | 3 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.2.2.2) heq
      | m+4 =>
        have ebefore : ∀ r, 0 < r → r ≤ 4 →
            u (i+(m+4)-r) = u (j+(m+4)-r) := by
          intro r hr hr4
          have q := ih (m+(4-r)) (by omega)
          have a : i+(m+4)-r = i+(m+(4-r)) := by omega
          have b : j+(m+4)-r = j+(m+(4-r)) := by omega
          simpa only [a,b] using q
        have e1 := ebefore 1 (by omega) (by omega)
        have e2 := ebefore 2 (by omega) (by omega)
        have e3 := ebefore 3 (by omega) (by omega)
        have e4 := ebefore 4 (by omega) (by omega)
        exact hstep _ _ (by omega) (by omega) e1 e2 e3 e4
  refine ⟨i,j-i,by omega,?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have h := hshift (n-i)
  have hi : i+(n-i)=n := by omega
  have hj : j+(n-i)=n+(j-i) := by omega
  rw [hi,hj] at h
  exact h.symm

(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)

: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  have h_main : ∃ (i j : ℕ), i < j ∧ (u i = u j ∧ u (i + 1) = u (j + 1) ∧ u (i + 2) = u (j + 2) ∧ u (i + 3) = u (j + 3)) := by
    obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
    classical
    let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
    have hf : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
      have hs : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
        have h0 := hB n
        have h1 := hB (n+1)
        have h2 := hB (n+2)
        have h3 := hB (n+3)
        simp only [Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def] at h0 h1 h2 h3 ⊢
        constructor <;> (try constructor) <;> (try constructor) <;> (try constructor) <;>
          (try simp_all [f]) <;> (try nlinarith)
      have hb : Set.Finite (Set.Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T)) := by
        apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T)))
        intro x hx
        simp_all [Set.mem_Icc]
        <;> aesop
      exact Set.Finite.subset hb hs
    have hp : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
      by_contra! h
      have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
        intro i j heq
        by_cases hne : i = j
        · exact hne
        · have hlt : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
          rcases hlt with hij | hji
          · exact False.elim (h i j hij heq)
          · exact False.elim (h j i hji heq.symm)
      exact Set.not_infinite.mpr hf (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj)
    obtain ⟨i,j,hij,hij'⟩ := hp
    refine ⟨i,j,hij,?_⟩

  have hstep : ∀ k l : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → 4 ≤ l →

      | 2 => simpa using heq.2.2.1
      | 3 => simpa using heq.2.2.2

        have b1 : j+(m+4)-1 = j+(m+3) := by omega
        have a2 : i+(m+4)-2 = i+(m+2) := by omega
        have b2 : j+(m+4)-2 = j+(m+2) := by omega
        have a3 : i+(m+4)-3 = i+(m+1) := by omega
        have b3 : j+(m+4)-3 = j+(m+1) := by omega
        have a4 : i+(m+4)-4 = i+m := by omega
        have b4 : j+(m+4)-4 = j+m := by omega
        have e1 : u (i+(m+4)-1) = u (j+(m+4)-1) := by
          simpa only [a1,b1] using ih (m+3) (by omega)
        have e2 : u (i+(m+4)-2) = u (j+(m+4)-2) := by
          simpa only [a2,b2] using ih (m+2) (by omega)
        have e3 : u (i+(m+4)-3) = u (j+(m+4)-3) := by
          simpa only [a3,b3] using ih (m+1) (by omega)
        have e4 : u (i+(m+4)-4) = u (j+(m+4)-4) := by
          simpa only [a4,b4] using ih m (by omega)
